flag_definitions.core: Directly required to produce this role's accountable outputs; depth expected at hiring + on the job.
flag_definitions.internal: Shared cross-functional capability the role must consume/contribute to interface with peers; working literacy, not depth.
flag_definitions.conditional: Required only when the stated trigger is true; not part of baseline hiring bar.

tier_definitions.foundational: Entry ramp / literacy for the role (levels Foundational*, All * in catalog).
tier_definitions.core: Working-depth material for the charter (levels Core, Core/advanced where used as baseline).
tier_definitions.advanced: Senior/specialist depth (Advanced, Professional, Reference, Staff+, Leadership).

evidence_levels.E3: URL returned HTTP 200 in the 2026-11-20 link check (220 of 296 probed).
evidence_levels.E2: Not probed in the 2026-11-20 pass, OR probed but blocked/ambiguous (403 bot-wall, SSL/timeout). Treat 403/SSL as WEAK signals (publisher bot-blocking), not dead links.
evidence_levels.E0-stale: HTTP 404 in the 2026-11-20 pass — replace or re-verify before relying on the mapping.
evidence_levels.E1: Scientific-library resources: report-curated, curator-attested at compile time (2026-11-20), not independently re-fetched.
evidence_levels.E0-vendor: SOTA model claims labeled [V] vendor-reported — never upgraded by the catalog build.

role_resource_fit_score.formula: weighted 0-5 per role-resource edge, weights inherited from workbook Selection_Rubric
notes: Sum of weights = 100; score each 0-5, normalize to 100.
adoption_signal must never be decisive alone (workbook rule).

role_depth_score.formula: 100 * (0.2*f_ok + 0.45*c_ok + 0.35*a_ok); counts exclude shared-literacy resources (>30 roles) and conditional-flag edges. Cascade: core resources count 0.5 toward the foundational target, advanced count 0.5 toward the core target.
penalties: -10 if any mapped resource is E0-stale
role_depth_score.interpretation: 90-100 hire-ready depth; 70-89 adequate with noted gaps; <70 charter exceeds resource coverage — close gaps before using the matrix as a learning path.

decomposition_trigger_score.rule: A combined role splits when ANY hard trigger fires OR >=2 soft triggers persist for 2 consecutive quarters.
hard_triggers: one half of the charter exceeds 1.0 FTE for 2 quarters
soft_triggers: hiring pipeline cannot find combined-profile candidates
duplicated work artifacts with sibling role
decomposition_trigger_score.anti_inflation_rule: No new standing role may be created for a capability that an existing charter can own as a conditional flag unless a hard trigger fires.

evaluation_tasks.task: Design-system release package (ui/ux labs 2, 5, 7): a three-tier DTCG 2025.10 token pipeline with version bump, changelog, and contrast report, plus a dual-engine accessibility audit (axe-core + pa11y) that separates automated findings from the manual checks still owed - an automated score is never presented as WCAG conformance.
evaluation_tasks.evidence_required: demonstrated

evaluation_tasks.task: Moderated usability study package: ISO 9241-11 research plan with consent and compensation records, a 6-session evidence log, and synthesis that reports n and segment per finding, scores SUS against the 68-norm percentile (never as a percentage), and declines to estimate population prevalence from qualitative data.
evaluation_tasks.evidence_required: demonstrated

evaluation_tasks.task: Prototype-fidelity drill (ui/ux labs 1, 10): label the requested prototype with its Houde-Hill question and declared fidelity (refusing to answer a role question with a hi-fi comp), then run a 7GUIs-style CRUD implementation with full keyboard support and undo/focus restoration, reporting success/error metrics.
evaluation_tasks.evidence_required: demonstrated

evaluation_tasks.task: Dark-pattern and standards-currency review: flag an asymmetric consent/cancel flow with a taxonomy citation (Brignull / Gray et al. / FTC) and propose the symmetric variant, while keeping WCAG 2.2 A+AA as the conformance baseline and refusing to present WCAG 3.0, ARIA 1.3, or APCA drafts as requirements.
evaluation_tasks.evidence_required: demonstrated

evaluation_tasks.task: Defend a cross-product design-system and research strategy: evidence-quality guardrails (observed behavior > self-report > heuristic judgment), research-repository custody with retention dates, and the documented split triggers (dedicated researcher when research cadence exceeds ~2 studies/month sustained; dedicated design-systems seat when >2 products consume one system) rather than title inflation.
evaluation_tasks.evidence_required: attested + demonstrated
